card.title: Winner Sets the Terms
card.instruction: Carry yourself as though success gives you the right to define the next challenge, the reward, and what counts as fair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As winner of family bowling, I choose where we eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only agreed you'd get a trophy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A trophy recognises judgement under pressure. Mine says pizza.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the next event is finding pizza he can eat. I'll award myself the biggest slice for organising it.

mechanism: A treats a bowling win as authority over dinner, reframes a dietary constraint as the next event and assigns A its reward.
confusable: Unlike simply demanding a prize, A claims the right to redefine both the challenge and fair compensation after winning.
comparison: The bowling alternative makes finding suitable pizza a new contest; the bake-off alternative changes next year's entry standard.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
